notes.title: Weekly Update #92: New logo and 53 bugs left
notes.notes:
Hi Fox Riders,

I caught a cold and I auto-quarantine myself. But we are not here to talk about me, right? 

We have a new logo! The game is feature complete, which means that everything we add now is part of the "nice to have" list (I think I already said that earlier ːepiwtfː). So, we are continuing to work on that magical list. The logo was part of that list, since the previous one was not super visible on small format. Here's the new one and the new animation for it ːepiloveː

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/0pdCd96bbphRtVLaie/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/f1017b4b2e391b2fb6bb76c82a03b2d560468391.png[/img]

[h3]About the BETA[/h3]

The closed BETA of the desert is going well. The BETA testers reported less bugs than expected. So, we have now a total of 53 bugs to fix for release. These bugs will be the main focus during the coming weeks. 

[h3]Next step[/h3]

As I told you before, the game release as been delayed a lot due to the fact that we have to release the Steam version at the same time as the STADIA version. The good news is that the STADIA version is going well. I am now waiting for the ratings (USK, ESRB, and PEGI) to come back to us. We are getting closer to that release, don't we?

This week we'll also work on adding the localized achievements, badges, emotes, and cards to Steam, so you will soon be able to use them. 

That's it for today. Thank you for reading. 

Cheers,
-VirginRedemption

notes.title: Announcement: Release and next updates
notes.notes:
Hi Fox Riders, 

I hope that you are all doing well wherever you are in this world. 

The COVID-19 situation affected us all personally in different ways, but it also affected the video game industry. On our side, we worked hard on Nanotale to meet our release deadline that was planned for the end October 2020. This is still something that we could reach but without the polish and testing that would require the game to be perfect. For these reasons, we decided to delay the release to early 2021. 

The good news is that, meanwhile, we secured a deal with STADIA allowing us to keep some cool features that we were sad to drop earlier. Thanks to that, we’ll be able to rework some parts of the game that were confusing or seemed unfinished from your feedback. 


[h2]NEXT UPDATES[/h2]

That said, it doesn’t mean that we won’t release anything until the final release. Of course, we will continue to update the game with some rework on the areas and the story of the game to make it a better experience. We also plan to add the voice over, so you will enjoy a more immersive game experience.


[h2]CLOSED BETA[/h2]

Moreover, we plan to do a closed beta of the final biome of Nanotale allowing some of you to reach the end of the game before the final release. We can’t say when yet, but we’ll let you know as soon as we can on our [url=http://www.discord.gg/fishingcactus]Discord server[/url]. 

Thank you for reading. If you have any questions, feel free to ask. We want to be completely transparent with you guys!

notes.title: Update #4 : Bug fixes and new patch
notes.notes:
Hello Fox Riders,

We have been working hard in the last few days to gather all the bugs and feedback reported to us via steam, discord and github.

I'm pleased to announce that the game stability has been greatly improved. 
To our knowledge, the game content for Early access is now finishable.

Here is today's patch changelog:

[list]
[*] Fixed all known blocking bridges in the game.
[*] Fixed a lot of transparent collision bugs happening in the game.
[*] Fixed All known NPC dialogues that were triggering game errors such as the impossibility to close a dialogue or the inability to type after such a dialogue was triggered.
[*] Fixed all known battle issues that were spawning Rosalind outside the game area upon death.
[*] Fixed known untypeable words in dialogues with NPC's.
[*] Fixed typing feedback on some UI elements.
[*] Fixed the path that was allowing users to reach the push/pull power zone without required fragments.
[*] Fixed Queen [spoiler] fight issues not handing you the teleport power[/spoiler].
[*] Improved enemy spawner visibility in dedicated combat zones.
[*] Temptative fix on green jaspers not being typeable in some parts of the game.
[*] Fixed issue linked to skipping mandatory dialogues (with ESCAPE).
[*] Improved map usefulness.
[*] Fixed the behaviour of the Fox upgrade power.
[/list]

KNOWN SHORTCOMINGS:

[list]
[*] Going back to the main menu from the game and then starting the game again breaks the game (bad checkpoint, not possible to type anymore). 
[*] [b]Changing the language[/b] from the options menu requires a [b]game restart[/b] to take the new language into account. It some cases, changing the language is not saved if you do not have any progression in the game.
[*] Polish and Russian might still have unrecognized character issues, we would love those of you who play in those languages to report any issue you encounter, it will help us greatly.
[*] Asian languages are not tested and should be used and played with extreme caution.
[/list]

Thank you everyone for your help, enjoy the game.

The Nanotale team.
